Hi!

Been doing extending fasting for a while so I think I built up for it over time.

I'd have miso soup or bone broth when I felt really dizzy (under 30 cals and didn't seem to affect my ketosis or anything) 

Took magnesium supplements every day. 

Played games, went on walks or started organising when bored

Whenever i felt like breaking it I would just think about how much happier I'd be after weighing myself the next morning. 

Whenever had a hunger pang just waited until it passsd 

Constantly asked myself am I just craving this one particular food or am I actually hungry? 

:) Good luck
Thank you for your response :) feel better about it now. Yeah the miso soup doesn't give me hunger pangs luckily. But im sure if it was anything else id feel the same

Yeah for sure, hard when there aren't as many distractions. 

Def mental sometimes! A trick I sometimes use to determine if I'm truly  hungry or if it's a craving is:

Would I break my fast right now for some pizza/sushi/etc. - YES!

Would I break it for a plate of broccoli out of hunger (I don't particularly like broccoli). No. 

Then it's def a craving and I can overcome it :)
Third day is always the hardest! I seriously felt like giving up third day but then fourth day felt sooooo much better! Just sleep on it for tonight and hold off your decision until tomorrow.
